Fieldwork

The best market research is still done on foot.

FIELDWORK by Earth5R takes students into their own neighbourhoods to work with the community on circular economy projects, with a mentor checking the work along the way. The customers, it turns out, live nearby.

Learn more at earth5r.org
jobs_ad_html: Fieldwork Planning a career in business? FIELDWORK by Earth5R is a mentored fellowship where school and university students work on a live Earth5R project near home and sit in on research conversations with professors at MIT, Oxford, Cambridge and LSE. The work is verified, which tends to come up in interviews. earth5r.org/fieldwork
